# Jetpack Markdown parser

`markdown/extra.php` and `markdown/gfm.php` are copied unchanged from Jetpack 16.3.1
(`_inc/lib/markdown/`), GPLv2 or later: PHP Markdown Extra by Michel Fortin with Jetpack's GitHub
Flavored Markdown extensions (`WPCom_GHF_Markdown_Parser`). They are the parser the WordPress.org
Markdown importer runs, vendored here so nothing has to be installed at build time.
